    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Controller
    Controls the flow of the message board application.
    DataInput
    Handles user input from the console.
    DescriptionPanel
     
    Display
    Handles the presentation of information to the user.
    Frame
    Represents the main application window hosting multiple panels using a CardLayout.
    MainMenuPanel
    Represents the main menu panel containing navigation options and application exit controls.
    Message
    Represents a single message entity containing text content.
    Messageboard
    The main entry point for the Messageboard application.
    MessagesManager
    Manages the collection of messages and the board description.
    MessagesPanel
    Represents the panel for viewing, adding, and deleting message board entries.
    WrongIndexException
    Custom exception thrown when an invalid message index is provided.
